$comment: Decisions for scripts/sync-npc-spawns.ts (docs/npc-spawns.md): Wiki spawns it labels in its report, and leaves out of npc-spawns.json when `skip` is true. `categories` are cache NPC categories (opcode 18), `ids` cache NPC ids, `names` cache NPC names, `namePatterns` regular expressions on them, `pagePatterns` regular expressions on the Wiki page title, `boxes` areas ("minX,minY,maxX,maxY[,plane]") such as instance templates a plugin spawns itself.

unalignedLayers.label: Wiki map layer not aligned
unalignedLayers.why: The Wiki draws some dungeons on their own map layers with other coordinates; when too few of a layer's spawns line up with existing ones to work out the shift, its spawns could land in the wrong place.

namePatterns.label: Minigame or scenery prop
namePatterns.why: Coloured names mark NPCs that are props of a minigame, raid or quest (Tempoross's crates, the Theatre of Blood's pillars, the Nightmare's totems): their content spawns them.

boxes.label: Spawned by a plugin
boxes.why: Pest Control's game island: PestControl.plugin.js spawns the Void Knight and the squire there.

boxes.label: Spawned by a plugin
boxes.why: The Theatre of Blood: TheatreOfBlood.plugin.js spawns each room's boss and Nylocas in the raid's instance.

boxes.label: Group Ironman island
boxes.why: The Node, where Group Ironman accounts start; its tutors and fake players aren't for other accounts.

pagePatterns.label: Quest only
pagePatterns.why: The zombies invading Varrock Palace exist only during Defender of Varrock.
